name: Onna no Ko Doushi ~Girl Playing Game~
original_name: 女の子どうし~Girl Playing Game~
source:
Main character dies in a traffic accident and now can possess bodies of other people, but only for a short time. He decides to infiltrate a girls school that his former girlfriend and sister attend.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-december-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公在一场车祸中死亡，现在能够附身在其他人身上，但只能维持很短的时间。他决定潜入前女友和妹妹就读的女子学校。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-december-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
